FACT-2.gloss: Charleston has four times as many sheep as Seattle

FACT-3.gloss: Toulouse has twice as many sheep as Charleston

RULE-1.gloss: If a city x has four times as many sheep as city y, and city y has 20 sheep, then city x has 80 sheep

RULE-2.gloss: If a city x has twice as many sheep as city y, and city y has 80 sheep, then city x has 160 sheep

RULE-3.gloss: If a city a has 20 sheep and a city b has 80 sheep and a city c has 160 sheep, then the total is 260
RULE-3.formula: ∀a∀b∀c((NumberOfSheepIn(a, n_20) ∧ NumberOfSheepIn(b, n_80) ∧ NumberOfSheepIn(c, n_160)) → TotalAcross(n_260))
